description: The records a resolver holds in its cache, with the seconds each has left: stored by the provider plugin as observations over the intervals its polls saw them (plugin_unbound.resource_record_observation, ADR 0020 wave 4); A, AAAA and CNAME records are kept, every other type counted.

cadences.basis: Decision 4 of specs/SPEC-resolver-cache-attribution.md: the cache read pairs with the lookup read, and a record inserted and expired between two polls is never seen, so the cadence is the lookups'. The dump's cost grows with the cache, which is why the read's availability detail records its size and its time.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every pass: reads the resolver and answers one row per record for the provider's own tables.
functions.name: collect
